freshness_caveat: Coal and Clean Dark data stale (240–245 days old; as-of 2025-12-26 and 2025-12-31). Coal at 7th-percentile and Clean Dark at 27.95 EUR/MWh not current; do not trade off these prices. All other metrics current as of 2026-08-27 to 2026-08-28.
risk_flags: Romanian offshore platform under hybrid-warfare attack; sustained disruption cuts 5–8% of EU gas inflow and forces TTF higher into refill season.
Danube drought escalates: nuclear cooling constraints (France, Germany, Romania) + hydropower shortfall (Central Europe) reduce non-gas supply by ~3–5 GW equivalent, forcing coal or TTF burn.
Storage 17 pp below seasonal norm; refill pace from September onward will determine Q4 power volatility and fuel-switch window width.
GB Power 98th-percentile (168 EUR/MWh) on 13.3% weekly surge suggests transmission stress or interconnector outage; elevated tail-risk into autumn.

base.summary: Renewables sustain 70%+ penetration; storage drifts toward seasonal norm; no new supply disruption.

downside.summary: Romanian platform operational restored; Danube levels stabilize; renewables extend into 80%+; storage injection accelerates.

upside.summary: Romanian platform offline sustained 1–2 weeks; Danube nuclear derating announced; TTF fuel-switch premium reasserts.

themes: Renewables at 95th-percentile suppress marginal cost; thermal call inverted
Geopolitical supply risk: Black Sea gas disruption + Danube drought tightens Cal+1
GB power premium (168 EUR/MWh) signals isolation and nuclear/hydro stress
Storage deficit (64% vs seasonal 81%) limits flexibility into autumn
top_drivers: Renewables at 95th-percentile (76% load share) suppress marginal cost today; but storage deficit + Danube drought reduce non-gas supply elasticity into Q4.
Geopolitical supply risk cluster: Black Sea gas sabotage + Iran sanctions tighten LNG arb; TTF upside into autumn refill.
GB Power 98th-percentile (168 EUR/MWh) signals thermal stress and interconnector constraint; premium widens if Danube cooling cuts France/Germany supply.
top_takeaway: GB Power at 98th-percentile amid 76% renewable penetration masks Danube drought and Romanian gas-platform sabotage risk; storage 17 pp below seasonal average sets H2 fuel-switch trigger.
